newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Securities cancels warning on TYK shares.
newsitem.headline: Japan Securities cancels warning on TYK shares.

text.p: A Japanese firm which borrows and lends shares said on Monday it had cancelled a recent warning to brokerages that it may run short of shares in TYK Corp.

Japan Securities Finance Co Ltd, which lends shares to brokerages for margin transactions with Finance Ministry authorisation, said in a statement it had cancelled the warning that it may have problems lending TYK shares in the future.
Brokerages borrow stocks from the company for clients wishing to sell them short in margin transactions.
